shard.name: Cloudflare Tunnel
shard.description: Cloudflared zero-trust connector daemon allowing secure outbound tunnels to publish game servers and web apps without open router ports.
shard.author: Cloudflare & Midnight Team
shard.installScript:
#!/bin/bash
# Cloudflared Installation Script for Midnight Panel
set -e
apk add --no-cache curl

cd /mnt/server
ARCH=$(uname -m)
if [ "$ARCH" = "x86_64" ]; then
    BIN="cloudflared-linux-amd64"
elif [ "$ARCH" = "aarch64" ]; then
    BIN="cloudflared-linux-arm64"
else
    BIN="cloudflared-linux-amd64"
fi

echo "Downloading Cloudflared for $ARCH..."
curl -o cloudflared -fSL "https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/releases/latest/download/${BIN}"
chmod +x cloudflared

echo "Cloudflared installation completed!"

variables.name: Cloudflare Tunnel Token
variables.description: The secret Tunnel token provided by the Cloudflare Zero Trust dashboard (Networks -> Tunnels).

variables.name: Additional Arguments
variables.description: Extra flags passed to cloudflared tunnel run (e.g. --loglevel debug).
